planAdvisor.description: Size Team vs Enterprise seats for a company-wide Claude rollout from a headcount and a technical fraction.
planAdvisor.headcountFlag: Total company headcount (whole number, at least 1).
planAdvisor.technicalFractionFlag: Share of headcount that would get a Claude Code seat, as a fraction 0–1 or a percentage like 50.
planAdvisor.tierMixFlag: Optional measured light,typical,power intensity split (e.g. 0.5,0.4,0.1); defaults to Anthropic's benchmark mix.
planAdvisor.complianceFlag: Surface the compliance trigger prominently. Does not change the numbers or pick a plan.
planAdvisor.title: Seat sizing for a company rollout
planAdvisor.seatRanges: Team seat range 5–150 · Enterprise minimums 20 self-serve / 50 sales-assisted (no published maximum).
planAdvisor.enterpriseCostHint: Enterprise = seat fee + metered usage benchmark; there is no bundled allowance.
planAdvisor.estimateNote: Every dollar figure is an estimate resting on the tier-mix assumption and the negotiated Enterprise seat floor — not a quote.
planAdvisor.ceilingExceeded: Team 150-seat ceiling exceeded — Enterprise required at this seat count.
planAdvisor.openQuestionsHeader: Open questions — decide these deliberately; this tool will not:

openQuestions.compliance: Compliance trigger: does your org handle regulated or customer data under obligations that make SSO/SCIM, audit logs, or custom retention non-cosmetic? This can force Enterprise regardless of seat count — a legal/IT judgment call, not a data question.
openQuestions.spendLimit: Spend-limit philosophy (Enterprise only): size per-user/org limits tight to the 'typical' benchmark (cost-predictable, power users occasionally throttled) OR at 2–3× the 'power' benchmark (usage-maximizing, limit as insurance against non-human failure modes like a leaked key). Both are legitimate; pick deliberately.
openQuestions.timing: Timing trigger: given the multi-week sales-assisted Enterprise lead time, decide the committed-seat count at which to start the Enterprise conversation — starting early converts a hard ceiling into a non-event.

errors.headcount-invalid: Headcount must be a whole number of at least 1.
errors.fraction-invalid: Technical fraction must be between 0 and 1 (or 0–100%).
errors.tiermix-invalid: Each tier-mix value must be between 0 and 1.
errors.adoption-fraction-invalid: Adoption fractions must be between 0 and 1.
errors.too-many-scenarios: At most 20 adoption scenarios are allowed.

commands.programDescription: Collect and analyse Claude Code usage statistics
commands.reportProject: Filter to a specific project path
commands.reportRepo: Filter to a specific git remote URL (e.g. https://github.com/org/repo)
commands.reportAccount: Filter to a specific account UUID (use 'list' to see known accounts)
commands.reportPeriod: Time period: day, week, month, or all (default: all)
commands.sinceFlag: Custom range start date (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive). Must be paired with --until; overrides --period when both are set.
commands.untilFlag: Custom range end date (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive). Must be paired with --since; overrides --period when both are set.
commands.reportDetail: Show per-session listing instead of aggregate
commands.reportTrend: Show usage broken down by time period instead of aggregate
commands.reportTicket: Show cost/tokens/sessions attributed to one ticket key (e.g. PROJ-123), plus the period's coverage
commands.reportSession: Show detailed view of a single session
commands.reportHtml: Write a self-contained HTML report to a file
commands.pack: Generate the justification pack: a self-contained HTML document plus a CSV bundle for one calendar month, for a reader who does not run claude-stats
commands.packPeriod: Calendar month to report on, YYYY-MM (required)
commands.packOut: Directory to write the pack bundle into (default: current directory)
commands.packJson: Print the written file paths as JSON instead of a summary line
commands.status: Show database size, row counts, and last collection time
commands.export: Export data to CSV or JSON
commands.exportFormat: Output format: csv or json (default: json)
commands.exportProject: Filter to a specific project path
commands.exportPeriod: Time period: day, week, month, or all
commands.diagnose: Show schema fingerprint diffs, quarantined lines, and version changes
commands.searchProject: Filter to a specific project path
commands.tagRemove: Remove the specified tags instead of adding
commands.tags: List all tags with session counts
commands.taskClass: Classify sessions into task classes and show the distribution
commands.taskClassLimit: Classify at most this many sessions in this run (resumable)
commands.backfill: Re-parse all session files to backfill new fields (e.g. prompt_text)
commands.serveOpen: Open in default browser after starting
commands.spending: Token spending breakdown — where did my tokens go?
commands.spendingPeriod: Time range: day, week, month, all (default: day)
commands.spendingTop: Number of top items to show (default: 5)
commands.spendingSort: Sort order: cost, tokens, prompts (default: cost)
commands.costPerTask: Cost per successful task — equivalent-API dollars per shipped/confirmed task, overall and per model
commands.costPerTaskPeriod: Time period: day, week, month, or all (default: month)
commands.costPerTaskByModel: Break the metric down by dominant model
commands.costPerTaskCalibrate: Output calibration metrics (proxy/signal agreement vs your labels) as JSON
commands.costPerTaskLlmJudge: Run the opt-in LLM judge on ambiguous tasks (needs llmJudge config; sends a blinded task summary to your endpoint)
commands.costPerTaskLlmJudgeUnconfigured: --llm-judge requested but llmJudge.endpoint/model are not set; skipping the judge.
commands.ticket: Link, negate, or list manual ticket attributions for a session
commands.ticketKeyArg: Ticket key (e.g. PROJ-123). Omitted with no other flag: lists current links
commands.ticketNegate: Tombstone this key for the session (suppresses it even if extraction keeps matching)
commands.ticketRemove: Remove a manual link for this key (does not affect the negation tombstone)
commands.ticketList: List ticket links for the session before applying any change
